text: Always be joyful.
Be still, and know that I am God!
He will show you a way out so that you can endure.
His peace will guard your hearts and minds.
Whatever is good and perfect is a gift.
It is not by force nor by strength, but by my Spirit.
It was very good!
The old life is gone; a new life has begun!
You will overflow with confident hope.
God causes everything to work together for the good.
Think about things that are excellent and worthy of praise.
Everything is possible with God.
I will never fail you. I will never abandon you.
Let the peace that comes from Christ rule in your hearts.
God intended it all for good.
God can be trusted to keep his promise.
The Lord is close to the brokenhearted.
God remains the strength of my heart; he is mine forever.
I am with you, and I will protect you wherever you go.
He will neither fail you nor abandon you.
Don’t be afraid. I am here to help you.
May he never leave us or abandon us.
Satisfy us each morning with your unfailing love.
Never stop praying.
He gives power to the weak and strength to the powerless.
Those who trust in the Lord will find new strength.
I can do everything through Christ, who gives me strength.
All the Lord’s promises prove true.
Your joy will overflow!
With his love, he will calm all your fears.
We know how much God loves us.
Don’t let evil conquer you, but conquer evil by doing good.
Seek his will in all you do.
My purpose is to give them a rich and satisfying life.
Put your hope in the Lord!
Guard your heart above all else.
The Lord will personally go ahead of you.
What we suffer now is nothing compared to the glory.
Everyone who believes in him will not perish but have eternal life.
The Lord is my light and my salvation.
Find rest in the shadow of the Almighty.
We will find grace to help us when we need it most.
Don’t be afraid, little flock.
He freed me from all my fears.
We live by believing and not by seeing.
Great is his faithfulness; his mercies begin afresh each morning.
Do everything with love.
It is more blessed to give than to receive.
If you need wisdom, ask our generous God.
Overwhelming victory is ours through Christ, who loved us.
Your workmanship is marvelous—how well I know it.
He gives us victory over sin and death.
We are God’s masterpiece.
Anything is possible if a person believes.
He heals the brokenhearted and bandages their wounds.
I will give you rest.
Give your burdens to the Lord.
Aren’t you far more valuable to him than they are?
God who takes care of me will supply all your needs.
Faith shows the reality of what we hope for.
You will receive power when the Holy Spirit comes upon you.
The light shines in the darkness.
God is our refuge and strength.
Weeping may last through the night, but joy comes with the morning.
This hope will not lead to disappointment.
Let all that I am wait quietly before God.
Faith, hope, and love—and the greatest of these is love.
The Lord is my strength and my song.
You are my hiding place; you protect me from trouble.
He is faithful and just to forgive us our sins.
Rejoice in our confident hope.
The Lord is for me, so I will have no fear.
He will restore, support, and strengthen you.
I will not be afraid, for you are close beside me.
A cheerful heart is good medicine.
I will rejoice in the Lord!
Keep on seeking, and you will find.
I know that you can do anything.
With God everything is possible.
May the Lord bless you and protect you.
Trust him, and he will help you.
Let’s not get tired of doing what is good.
The Lord is my shepherd; I have all that I need.
Do it as a representative of the Lord Jesus.
Now all glory to God.
He gives us grace and glory.
My grace is all you need.
Be kind to each other, tenderhearted, forgiving one another.
The Lord looks at the heart.
This is the day the Lord has made.
To give you a future and a hope.
Always be full of joy in the Lord.
Christ has truly set us free.
I will strengthen you and help you.
God, who began the good work within you, will continue his work.
Take delight in the Lord.
Commit your actions to the Lord.
Jesus Christ is the same yesterday, today, and forever.
Give all your worries and cares to God.
Let your good deeds shine out for all to see.
The faithful love of the Lord never ends! His mercies never cease.
Take heart, because I have overcome the world.
God saved you by his grace when you believed.
Our spirits are being renewed every day.
Blessed are those who trust in the Lord.
There is no condemnation for those who belong to Christ Jesus.
His unfailing love continues forever.
My help comes from the Lord, who made heaven and earth!
Taste and see that the Lord is good.
I am leaving you with a gift—peace of mind and heart.
Encourage each other and build each other up.
Be strong and courageous, and do the work.
The joy of the Lord is your strength!
May the Lord smile on you and be gracious to you.
Trust in the Lord with all your heart.
Search for the Lord and for his strength; continually seek him.
If God is for us, who can ever be against us?
The Lord your God is with you wherever you go.
The Lord will guide you continually.
God has not given us a spirit of fear and timidity.
Infinitely more than we might ask or think.
Be thankful in all circumstances.
The name of the Lord is a strong fortress.
Seek the Kingdom of God above all else.
Be strong in the Lord and in his mighty power.
Don’t worry about anything; instead, pray about everything.
He is the faithful God who keeps his covenant.
My faithful love for you will remain.
I will not fail you or abandon you.
I have loved you, my people, with an everlasting love.
I will give you a new heart.
I am the vine; you are the branches.
I am the resurrection and the life.
I will give you rest—everything will be fine for you.
You have already won a victory.
I am with you always, even to the end of the age.
Be strong and courageous, for your work will be rewarded.
Don’t let your hearts be troubled.
To love mercy, and to walk humbly with your God.
You will keep in perfect peace all who trust in you.
The Lord himself will fight for you.
When you go through deep waters, I will be with you.
Do to others as you would like them to do to you.
The Lord is faithful; he will strengthen you.
I will put my hope in God!
The Lord is my strength and shield.
I am the light of the world.
When I am afraid, I will put my trust in you.
I know that my Redeemer lives.
He will wipe every tear from their eyes.
May the Lord show you his favor and give you his peace.
His faithful love endures forever.
Your comfort gave me renewed hope and cheer.
The word of God will never fail.
